title: Storage Exit Check
summary: Check a storage move and test a restore sample before cancelling cloud storage.
user: Privacy-conscious individuals moving files from cloud storage to a NAS or local disks who need evidence their replacement is complete and recoverable before cancelling a subscription.
smallest_useful_product: A local CLI that snapshots two directory trees, explains count, size, and hash differences, selects a reproducible restore sample, and emits a printable cancellation-ready report.
constraints: Read-only by default; support report redaction; never imply a sample proves disaster recovery; document timestamp and symlink differences.
